the age of best performance increased and performance deteriorated in ultra-marathons, the age of best ultra-marathon increased with increasing race distance, and performance improved with increasing experience.
the age of the best performance increases with increasing race duration in time-limited ultramarathons, and that the age of best performance increases with the number of finishes.

the age of peak and best ultra-marathon performances and the number of ultra-marathon finishes.

the age for the highest ultra-marathon performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the age of ultra-marathon performance increases with increasing number of ultra-marathon finishes and with increasing race duration.
the age of the fastest ultra-marathons performance increased with increasing distance and increasing number of finishes.
the age of the fastest ultra-marathons in time-limited events increased with increasing race distance and with increasing number and duration of ultra-marathons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the age for the peak ultra-marathon performances is not fixed but increases with increasing race duration as well as with increasing number of ultra-marathon finishes.
the age of the best performance increases with increasing race duration.
the age of the best performances in ultra-marathons increases with increasing race duration.
